title_en: Surprise hunt, pattern class 1 non-monotone learning curve (exploratory)
title_zh: 意外发现搜索：1 学习曲线随样本变大反而变差（探索性）
reading_en: Of 24159 hypotheses scanned (40356 in all classes), 443 pass the false-discovery control (q <= 0.10); they have NOT yet been re-run on fresh draws, so none is a finding.
reading_zh: 共扫描24159个这类假设（所有类别合计40356个），443个通过假发现率控制(q<=0.10)；尚未用新抽样重跑，所以都还不算发现。
rule: X11 (exploratory, pre-registered): scan every curve for non-monotone shapes and sign reversals; Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 within the class; each hit re-run on fresh seeds, reported as found / replicated / not replicated. Class verdict rule (fixed before use): supported = at least half of ALL FDR hits of the class replicate (hits that could not be re-run count as not replicated); mixed = some but fewer; not supported = no FDR hit or none replicated; not testable = hits not yet re-run or cells missing.

examples.reading_en: On brightkite (subgroup activity:2, k=5), the NDCG@100 against the reference list of the 75% blend of sample and global falls from 0.433 at N=10 to 0.098 at N=20, although more people were sampled.
examples.reading_zh: 在brightkite（子群activity:2，每人5条）上，样本与全体榜75%混合的榜的对参考榜的NDCG@100从N=10时的0.433降到N=20时的0.098，尽管抽的人更多了。
